claims.evidence: The witness report shows a used engine assembly, but no readable documentation, import markings, or guarantee terms are visible.

risks.risk: Engine make/model, displacement, and configuration are not readable, so compatibility and true value are uncertain.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine ID/plate and casting marks (front/rear block stamping) plus any readable label on the intake/exhaust area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unidentified used engine assembly (worst-case: unknown specs/compatibility).

risks.risk: Unknown running condition (may be seized, low compression, or damaged internally).
risks.proof: Video clip of a cold start (or at minimum a compression test sheet/reading) showing it cranks and runs smoothly.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-verified/untested engine (worst-case: may be for parts or needs overhaul).

risks.risk: Turbo/large intake duct presence suggests a turbo setup; turbo failure or oil-feed issues could be costly.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the turbo unit and oil/coolant feed/return lines, plus a short clip showing boost/whistle during a run (or turbo inspection report).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as turbo system unverified (worst-case: turbo may need replacement/repair).

risks.risk: Missing parts and accessory condition (belts, sensors, alternator/starter, hoses) could make it unusable without extra spend.
risks.proof: A full inventory photo/clip laid out (or a checklist photo) showing all included accessories and sensors, with readable part numbers where possible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown accessories (worst-case: buyer must source missing items).

risks.risk: Leaks and seal/gasket condition are unknown (oil/coolant leaks, cracked hoses, worn gaskets).
risks.proof: Photos of the engine base, oil pan area, coolant lines, and any wet spots/staining; plus a run clip showing no leaks.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potential leak/overhaul risk (worst-case: reseal required).

risks.risk: Transmission/gearbox compatibility is unknown if any mating parts are included (or if it’s engine-only).
risks.proof: Photos showing what is included (engine-only vs engine+gearbox) and any gearbox model/plate if present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as engine assembly only with unknown mating compatibility.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of the engine ID/plate and any readable casting/stamping marks (front/rear block).
Video of the engine cranking and starting (or compression test results).
Close-up photos of the turbo and all oil/coolant feed/return connections.
Inventory photo/list of included parts (alternator, starter, sensors, belts, hoses, intake/exhaust components) with readable labels where possible.
Photos of potential leak points (oil pan, valve cover area, coolant lines) and any staining/wetness.
Confirm whether it includes transmission/gearbox; if yes, provide gearbox model/plate photo.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a used engine assembly, but the make/model and running condition are not verifiable from the report. Without at least engine ID and proof it runs (or compression), a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
